publication.authorization: Representative explicitly requested consolidation into main.
publication.protocol: Publish the checked tree only while the expected main and four delivery heads still match; preserve the original five parents.
publication.publicationReceipt: The resulting GitHub main commit/history is the publication receipt; this file records prepublication checks, not a self-referential published commit ID.

testTotals.scope: Offline engineering/authored fixture compatibility; no independent model accuracy denominator.

observed: copy/manual fallback/print protected footer and stale-copy rejection
no horizontal overflow, browser storage, external evidence requests or page errors in the checked journey
browser.screenshotsLocation: Ignored .local-data/build-checks/preview-mobile.png and result-mobile.png; not a public delivery.

documentationCheck.limits: Documentation/schema/authored fixture compatibility only. No app/controller/live-model/held-out/student/device/processor effectiveness result.

preservation.designTreeAndRootLocales: Exact source blobs unchanged, including frozen-v1/v2.
preservation.originalMemberHistory: Retained as integration parents, including both CS commits.
preservation.privatePaths: Credentials/configs, personal experiment logs, raw participants, local caches, held-out text and local agent rules excluded.

technicalReview.scope: Shared entry/mode, source/body bounds, response identity, stale exports and exact Design locale preservation. This is technical agent review, not human content or release acceptance.

remainingGates: CS/AI-DS: controlled live provider/browser integration and full correction/reply lifecycle
Communication: source/new-prose approval and deck/submission preparation
Design: connected interface review and physical devices
DASE: same-revision independent model scoring and consenting student observations
Representative: decide and record evidenced release configuration
limits: A consolidated source tree and local simulation pipeline do not complete all work packages or establish competition readiness, independent accuracy, physical-device or user acceptance.

postTestIntegrationChanges.CSLateMerge: Verified no runtime/dependency/test delta; retained current setup incorporating both CS corrections.
postTestIntegrationChanges.sharedManifest: CS source head/checkpoint only; typecheck and production build rerun after metadata change.
postTestIntegrationChanges.other: Current English guides/evidence pointers and check record; no module/policy/schema/fixture/locale change.
